Autonomy Nuke profile 2026.10.16

  • First release with updates: Script > Nuke Profile > Check for Updates
  • Nuke to Fusion: Option+Cmd+V pastes Nuke nodes; Import Nuke Script brings in a whole .nk
  • Fusion to Nuke: Copy to Nuke and Export Nuke Script, with edits made in Fusion carried back
  • Manual and per-tool rundown in docs/
